messages:
Maggie: Hey team — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1284 is ready but gated on architecture review + RFC. Linking RFC: https://rfc.redwood.ai/rfcs/2026-03-kv-cache-routing. Can someone from arch take a quick look? We want to merge before next release slot (Thu AM) but won't merge without arch ack.

Alex: noted, can you paste a 2‑line summary of the change and the expected SLO delta?

Maggie: Sure — summary: shard-aware prefix caching + routing rule that prefers local KV store for short requests to reduce p99 CPU. Expected SLO delta: +1–3ms p99 on tail for cross-shard fallbacks, typical latency unchanged. Cost down ~8% for our short-sequence workloads.

Ravi: Thanks. Two quick asks before I can LGT: 1) show the fallback policy (what triggers cross-shard read), 2) ensure we have a canary with automatic rollback if errors > 0.5% over 5m.

Maggie: Fallback policy is in the PR description (snippet below):

```
if local_kv_miss_count / requests_last_5m > 0.02: route to cross-shard with async prefetch
else: stick to local_kv with sync fallback on miss
```

Canary plan (proposed): 5% global traffic for 30m -> 25% for 2h -> 100% if error and latency metrics stable. Rollback rule: error rate > 0.5% or p99 increase > 8ms.

CI-bot: CI passed — 142 tests, 0 failures. :white_check_mark:

Julie: I can take a look at the code tonight, but will need the perf graphs for short-sequence vs long-sequence. Maggie, can you attach a sample perf run?

Maggie: attaching short perf run numbers inline: baseline p99=48ms, patched p99=49.5ms; baseline cost per 1k tokens $0.82, patched $0.75. Longseq no change. Also added a perf dashboard link: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/kv-cache/patch-1284

Ravi: Looks reasonable. One design note: prefer making the async prefetch TTL configurable via runtime flag so ops can tune without redeploy. Can you add that?

Maggie: yep — will add `--kv-prefetch-ttl` flag and update PR. Will also add a short note in rollout docs about observed regression window and rollback thresholds.

Alex: Pinged infra to reserve a quiet release window Thu 02:00–03:30 UTC for the canary dry-run. :rocket:

Ravi: If Maggie pushes the TTL flag and the docs, I can give arch ack. Otherwise hold.

Maggie: pushed the flag and docs, updated PR description. Requesting final arch eyes.

Ravi: Arch ack with one follow-up (ops flag naming nit) — fine to merge after Julie does a quick code pass. :thumbsup:

Julie: quick pass done, left one minor comment about a null check. Non-blocking. Approving after fix.

Maggie: fixed the null check and squashed. Thanks all — marking ready to merge after release window reserved.

SRE-bot: Noted release window reservation from Alex. Please file a post-deploy check run: https://ops.redwood.ai/checks/1284

Alex: I'll do the post-deploy run and monitor metrics during canary.

Maggie: awesome — closing the loop here. Will not merge until Thu 02:00 UTC and after final CI + canary start. :white_check_mark:
